name: How long does a typical rental unit renovation project take with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical rental unit renovation project take with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a rental unit renovation project with AKN Design Group varies significantly based on its scope and complexity. A full kitchen remodel or bathroom renovation might take several weeks, while a whole-home remodel or addition will require a more extensive timeline. Our integrated design-build process prioritizes clear communication and efficient scheduling, but we emphasize craftsmanship and thorough execution over rushed timelines. We provide upfront estimates and scheduling transparency from concept to completion.
